message.content: {"objective": "Verify Nxf7 as the primary candidate; compare with Nxe4 and Be3 to keep a development alternative.", "rationale": "Broad depth-3 search gave Nxf7 exact 373, leading a pack of upper-bound 369 moves (Be3, Bf2, g3, h4). Nxf7 sacrifices the knight for e6/f7 pawns but forces Kxf7 and leaves White a piece down for two pawns unless a follow-up (Ne4) recovers material; the shallow PV ends there, so I need verification at depth 4 with the reserved nodes. I will also spend comparison reserve on Nxe4 (centralize/recover the d4 pawn pressure) and Be3 (develop, challenge the d4 pawn) to have a sound alternative if Nxf7 fails. No mate-in-one checks or king moves to worry about here.", "action": "analyze", "candidate_moves": ["e5f7"], "max_nodes": 2000, "max_depth": 4}
